latest_release.name: Strata 0.2.16: Strata's own engine code, a new folder layout, and a long list of fixes
latest_release.body:
# Strata 0.2.16: Strata's own engine code, a new folder layout, and a long list of fixes

The app and the Terminal are 0.2.16. The engines are 0.1.62 on every platform, and so is Control, the small program that installs and updates them (there is no engine 0.1.61 release; Control and the engines share one number from here). The update feed is sequence 128.

## What changes for you

- Update as usual (see Updating below). Your models, chats and settings stay.
- The engines are new downloads: `strata update` and the app fetch them. Every platform has one (Windows, Linux, Mac, DGX Spark).
- Mac M1, M2, M3 or M4 with UD-Q4_K_XL: update. 0.2.15 gave wrong results there (next section).
- Two ways Strata could stop with no message are fixed: a crash at start on some Windows accounts, and Ubuntu's memory guard ending a model load (reduced, not removed: see Known problems).
- On Windows, typing `strata` in a default PowerShell works now.
- If you build Strata from a clone: the top-level folders moved into `engine/`, `app/`, `terminal/`, `docs/` and `tools/`. Build the engine with `cmake -S engine`.
- New settings are off by default.

## Mac M1 to M4: 0.2.15 gave wrong results with UD-Q4_K_XL (fixed, #4141)

On an M1, M2, M3 or M4, 0.2.15 computed only a quarter of the columns in some layers (160 of 640 in the layer we measured). The text still read fluently, so a short answer does not show it. The M5 was not affected. Against the same Mac's default path, on 6 prompts of 512 to 8,192 tokens, the first-token difference (KL) fell from 0.303 to 0.0068, and the top token differed on 1 of 6 prompts instead of 3 of 6. We measured this on an M5 Max forced onto the older kernels, because we had no M1 to M4 Mac. Fix by macintog.

## What is new

- **Strata's own engine code.** The engines for NVIDIA, AMD, Intel Arc and the Mac run on Strata's own code, with no ggml and no llama.cpp matrix kernels. The picture reader is Strata's own too: its file went from 53,864,888 bytes to 807,976 bytes on NVIDIA.
- **The answers did not change.** On our 10 test prompts (chat, code, a tool call, long pastes, Chinese, German, a picture), the new engines gave the same tokens as 0.2.15's on the RTX PRO 5000 (9 of 9), Tesla P100 (10 of 10), Radeon R9700 (10 of 10), Arc A750 (9 of 9), M5 Max (10 of 10) and Strix Halo (9 of 9 text prompts). The exceptions: the Strix Halo picture answer (intended change in the picture reader), 4 short prompts on the DGX Spark (small number differences, same tokens), and the Windows CUDA 12 engine on an RTX 5070 (2 of 10 answers differ, because it now has native code for that card).
- **Faster long prompts on older NVIDIA cards.** Tesla V100, a 26,000-token prompt: 17,464 ms with 0.1.58 and 15,068 ms now. RTX 2080 Ti at 26,000 tokens, speed against 0.1.58: 0.885 in 0.2.15 and 1.088 now.
- **The chat shows what the model is doing** ("Thinking…", "Calling read…", "Writing file app.js…"). A tool call that cannot run no longer ends the turn: the agent gets an error that lists its tools and goes on (20 of 20 in our live check).

## Fixed

**Windows**
- A crash at start on accounts that Windows refuses a system query (WMI), such as a standard user over ssh, is fixed. The background program, the server and the engine ended about 5 seconds after start. On Strix Halo, 3 of 3 starts crashed before; after the fix a full `strata launch` served after 73 s with a chat, a tool call and a picture. A normal desktop user on an RTX 5070 PC was not affected. 0.2.15 has the crash too. Issue #4200 may be the same cause; we could not check it.
- `strata` works in a default PowerShell. Before, PowerShell refused `strata.ps1` ("running scripts is disabled"). An older install is fixed on its first `strata` command after the update.
- `install.ps1` no longer rewrites your user PATH. It added Strata's folder but changed the type of the value and dropped the last `;`.
- `UPDATE.bat` of an old clone ends with exit code 0. Before, it printed "The batch file cannot

Run powerful AI on your own computer.

Chat, code and work with images, locally.

Models · Install · Hardware · Tools · Help · Support

English · 简体中文 · 日本語 · Deutsch · Français · Español · Português · Polski

**Free, open source, and yours to run.** Use Strata on your desktop or with your favorite coding tools. No account needed. ## Models We recommend **ISTA-DASLab first**, then **Unsloth** and other providers, where a compatible model fits.
 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next | Provider | Choices | | --- | --- | | **ISTA-DASLab · recommended** | Q2\_0, IQ2\_XS, IQ3\_XXS, IQ3\_S. [Coder: IQ1\_M](docs/MODELS.md#coder) for coding. | | **Unsloth** | UD-IQ4\_XS, UD-Q4\_K\_XL, UD-Q5\_K\_XL, UD-Q6\_K\_XL, Q8\_0 | | **Gyro · agentionai** | [Gyro-S, Gyro-M](https://huggingface.co/agentionai/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Gyro-GGUF). Lower memory use but slower. | | **Other options** | [Swift 1.5](docs/MODELS.md#swift-15), [NVFP4](docs/NVFP4.md), [OrcaRouter](docs/ORCA.md) | [Compare sizes, memory needs and compatibility](docs/MODELS.md).
 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B **Unsloth:** UD-Q4_K_XL, UD-Q6_K_XL, Q8_0. These are the currently documented packs for this model. [Model guide and compatibility](docs/QWEN36.md).
Not sure what fits? [Choose a model for your computer](docs/MODELS.md#pick-by-memory). ## Install ### Desktop app **[Download Strata for Windows, Linux or Mac →](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases/latest)** Install the app, choose a model, and start chatting. There is one installer for each system. On first start the app downloads the engine for your graphics card. [Help with the installer](docs/INSTALL.md#the-app). Files: `Strata-0.2.16-windows-x64-setup.exe` · `Strata-0.2.16-linux-x86_64.AppImage` · `Strata-0.2.16-macos-arm64.dmg`


Chat, files and a live preview in one window.

### Terminal app Prefer the terminal? Install Strata, then run **`strata launch`**.
Install commands **Linux / Mac** ```sh curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 120 https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases/latest/download/install.sh -o install.sh && sh install.sh ``` **Windows PowerShell** ```powershell irm -TimeoutSec 120 https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 | iex ``` On Windows, open a new terminal afterwards. Then: ```sh strata launch ``` Follow the prompts to download and start a model. [Terminal guide](docs/TERMINAL_LAUNCH.md).


Watch your model and hardware while it runs.

[Build from source](docs/SOURCE_INSTALL.md) · [Docker](docs/DOCKER.md) · [Full install guide](docs/INSTALL.md) ## Hardware | Supported hardware | Guide | | --- | --- | | **NVIDIA GeForce RTX 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 series** | [NVIDIA setup](docs/INSTALL.md#what-you-need) | | **AMD Radeon RX 7700 / 7800 / 7900, RX 9060 / 9070, AI PRO R9700** | [AMD setup](docs/AMD_HIP.md) | | **AMD Radeon RX 6800 / 6900 · experimental** | [RX 6000 setup](docs/AMD_HIP.md#rdna2-gfx1030) | | **Intel Arc · Linux** | [Intel setup](docs/INTEL_ARC.md) | | **Apple Silicon · M1 or newer** | [Mac setup](docs/MAC.md) | | **AMD Ryzen AI Max · Strix Halo** | [Strix Halo setup](docs/STRIX_HALO.md) | | **NVIDIA DGX Spark · Linux** | [DGX Spark setup](docs/DGX_SPARK_LINUX.md) | ## Tools **Claude Code · Codex CLI · OpenCode · oh-my-pi · pi.dev · Hermes Agent · OpenClaw**, and more through the OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs. Run **`strata connect`** to see setup instructions for your tool. [Connection guide](docs/TERMINAL_LAUNCH.md#connect-your-apps-strata-connect). ## Help [All guides](docs) · [Troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md) · [Report a bug](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/issues/new/choose) · [Benchmarks](docs/COMMUNITY_BENCHMARKS.md) · [How it works](docs/HOW_IT_WORKS.md) · [Contribute](.github/CONTRIBUTING.md) ## Support Strata **Help keep local AI open to everyone.** A GitHub sponsorship or a coffee helps fund development and testing on more hardware. ### Loyal supporters Thank you to everyone who supports Strata. All supporters and how to support Strata: [SUPPORTERS.md](SUPPORTERS.md) [MIT license](LICENSE) · [Credits and model licenses](docs/HOW_IT_WORKS.md#credits) · [Privacy](docs/SAFETY.md) For AI tools and automated readers: technical reference · setup instructions. **Sponsorships, hardware partnerships or collaborations:** [niko.veit@outlook.com](mailto:niko.veit@outlook.com).
